items.title: On an integral normal scheme with separably closed function field every separated etale morphism splits as a disjoint union of open immersions and all local rings are strictly henselian
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises integral normal schemes with separably closed function field: separated etale maps split into open immersions, and every local ring is strictly henselian (statement lines 14311-14320). The proof (proof lines 14322-14366) first settles the affine case, where normality forces the idempotents of A tensor_R K to lie in A and the radicial-etale criterion turns the resulting bijectivity of A tensor_R A -> A into an open immersion; the global statement follows by decomposing an affine piece of U along the generic points of its fibre and using separatedness for injectivity, and part (2) is read off from the description of strict henselisations. H2: an explicit affine argument followed by a two-step global reduction.
